<p class="note">Written by `create_report()` from a `decompose_trait()` result
(gpmapr `r d$gpmapr_version`, run `r format(d$created, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")`).
Each SNP associated with the trait is described by its effects on every other
GPMap trait it colocalizes with; empirical Bayes matrix factorisation (EBMF)
groups SNPs whose profiles move together into overlapping **programs**, each a
candidate biological mechanism behind the trait.</p>

